description: Describe what you need to do (e.g. 'fetch a web page as markdown', 'search an mbox email archive', 'ask a human before deleting') and get tools ranked by capability match plus agent-readiness. Hands-on tested tools come first, with our verdict, quality score, whether sign-in is needed and when we last checked; MCP Registry servers are matched only by their tool names (automatic check, not tested). Each result says why it matched and links to its page. Same as GET /api/find?task=.
